design_choices.hidden_joinery: simplified; exposed seats, gong eyes and member profiles must remain represented
design_choices.ornament: no optional procession of ridge animals; required ridge terminals and corner attachments retained

window_panel.gap_policy: gaps between mullions only; panel sits inside the selected bay

vertical_convention.basis: project interpretation; not the only reading of nominal window height
vertical_convention.nominal_height: H is the proportional module derived from the horizontal count/gap equation
vertical_convention.embedding: two thirds of subframe height at each end
vertical_convention.hidden_joint: recesses in the head and waist are simplified

ridge_courses.basis: selected construction dimensions, independent of source layer counts

chiwei.basis: text height range; project-selected width/depth and outline from comparative painting
chiwei.simplification: carved relief omitted; iron supports and five-prong deterrent retained; concealed seating simplified

ordinary_ang.basis: project-selected reading of the published five-puzuo slope and YF17 member length
ordinary_ang.length_datum: body centerline from outer head shoulder to concealed tail, excluding exposed tip; CORNER_STUDY Fig3 explicit four/five/six-puzuo convention

column_head_riding.retained: first radial hua and first-jump bearing dou
column_head_riding.replaced_by_mingfu: inner second radial member and inner crossing gong stacks at the beam only; two sides at inner-column beam junctions
column_head_riding.boundary: intercolumn assemblies retain the inner double jump; native joint inspection pending

subsidiary_wall_bearing.basis: project-selected corbel and dou shoulder supporting the wall end; concealed column tenon simplified

corner_rafter_distribution.basis: project-derived fan interpolation over selected nine-chi corner zone; shared endpoints between round and flying rafters

corner_bracket.basis: project reconstruction following the declared published length/slope reading, not a unique historical prescription
corner_bracket.return_gong_span: selected extended span to the diagonal bearing, not equated to the source body-length entry
corner_bracket.hidden_joint: scarf/half-lap solids simplified; exposed diagonal ludou slot retained

angle_beams.basis: selected dimensions within text ranges; upper supports drive segmented members
angle_beams.concealed_lap: child beam embedded inside main beam; concealed mating recess omitted

subsidiary_ridge.basis: project-selected nine-course low hip seam; subsidiary has no separate main ridge
subsidiary_ridge.source_comparison: YF13 gallery ridge counts; selected for this annular subsidiary roof, not prescribed uniquely by FIG13

corner_ornaments.subsidiary: project-selected same small corner terminal set; no large hip beast
corner_ornaments.silhouettes: project-authored plain ceramic head/body/wing/tail masses, not excavated-object replicas; carved facial/feather relief omitted
corner_ornaments.position: derived from roof terminal and ridge cap surfaces; individual spacing selected

end_framing.basis: selected end dingfu to nearest transverse caofu, crossing mojiao member and short posts following actual purlin underside
end_framing.hidden_joints: simplified; bearing coordinates share column rise and roof fold functions

short_beam_profile.basis: project fitting rule for short subsidiary spans
short_beam_profile.rule: upper six-cut and lateral four-cut shoulder runs shorten only if the fixed runs would cross the opposite end

known_limitations: Frozen means dimensions and declared reconstruction choices are fixed; it does not claim native acceptance or conservation certification.

The preset uses FIG13 topology, text dimensions and an explicitly selected published corner interpretation. It is not an exact reconstruction of a surviving named building or every historical stock-count entry.
Concealed mortises, mating recesses, embedded laps and scarves are simplified. Exposed dou slots, beam necks, principal sections and assembly bearings remain represented.
The extended corner return-gong span, subsidiary ridge courses, short-beam fitting and plain ornament silhouettes are project choices, not unique prescriptions of the text.
No polychrome painting, complex carving or other dynastic systems. No structural/load calculation is provided.
